methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and verified directly for each vendor: procore.com/pricing, buildertrend.com/pricing, getjobber.com/pricing, fieldwire.com/pricing, contractorforeman.com/pricing, houzz.com/houzz-pro/pricing, knowify.com/pricing, buildxact.com/us/pricing, and rakenapp.com/plans. Procore, Buildertrend, Houzz Pro, and Raken do not publish self-serve prices and are listed quote-only (monthlyUsd: null). Jobber, Contractor Foreman, Buildxact, and Knowify publish explicit prices, all confirmed exactly on the live pages. monthlyUsd reflects the standard monthly-billing rate; annual-billing equivalents and discount % are noted per plan. Fieldwire's pricing page renders only annual per-user rates ($39/$64/$89 for Pro/Business/Business Plus); the monthly-billed rates ($54/$74/$104) are corroborated by third-party pricing analyses (scanmanifold, ITQlick, G2). Knowify Advanced's annual rate ($399) is genuinely higher than its monthly rate ($329) — no annual discount on that tier — confirmed on the live page (not a display anomaly). Telephony fields are null (not a telephony vertical). All prices USD. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Procore
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched procore.com/pricing directly; pricing is ACV-based (Annual Construction Volume) and entirely quote-only — no plan names or prices published. Page confirms unlimited users/data/24-7 support, modular product selection, custom annual quote via sales. Compliance verified on procore.com/trust-and-security/security.

plans.name: Custom (ACV-based)
plans.notes: Priced annually based on Annual Construction Volume (aggregate dollar value of construction work). Unlimited users, unlimited data/storage, and 24/7 support included. Modular product selection; pay only for products selected. No prices published — contact sales.

limits: Pricing based on Annual Construction Volume (ACV)
Modular — pay only for products selected
keyFeatures: ACV-based annual pricing with unlimited users
SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certified
enrichment.provenance: Verified procore.com/pricing (quote-only, ACV-based) and procore.com/trust-and-security/security. Explicitly claims SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRAMP Moderate (gov), and GDPR/CCPA support. HIPAA not claimed (null).

plans.name: Business Plus
